headline: It's Not Your
Metabolism

concepts.A: Dan is standing upright at his own bright contemporary kitchen island, naturally placing hard-boiled eggs and a grilled salmon fillet into a clear meal-prep container at hip level to one side, leaving the entire torso and defined abs unobscured. He looks to camera with a confident relaxed closed-mouth smile. A few fresh vegetables on the counter, tidy and restrained. Bright natural morning window light, navy and warm wood kitchen. Chest fully extended, not bent over. A real-camera candid meal-preparation photograph.
concepts.B: Dan is climbing a broad outdoor urban staircase toward the camera, carrying one small gym duffel at his side. One foot on the next step, torso upright and extended, shoulders relaxed, lean clearly defined abs. He looks calmly determined. Pale concrete stairs, strong blue sky and warm directional sunlight, energetic real-camera sports editorial photograph. Head to knees composition, all visible body parts intact. The stairs are empty of all other people.
concepts.D: Dan is in his private home gym doing a standing dumbbell shoulder press. Two ordinary black dumbbells, one held correctly in each hand above and to either side of his head, elbows natural, arms and weights completely inside the frame. Torso upright and extended, abs uncovered, focused relaxed face. One whole person, realistic hands and joints, realistic shoulder-press position. Dark home gym with warm red accent lights and crisp side lighting. Frame head through mid thighs. Do not crop hair, hands or dumbbells.
concepts.E: Dan is standing beside a bedroom window in clear early morning light and naturally pulling back one curtain with one outstretched arm. His other arm rests at his side. He looks refreshed and quietly happy after sleeping well, relaxed closed-mouth smile. His lean chest and defined abs are fully visible, torso upright and extended. A tidy bed in the distant background. Cool teal shadows and soft golden sunlight, intimate real-camera lifestyle photograph. No other people.
concepts.C: Original real studio-white-49 photograph/cutout. Full original person pixels, warm clean background, large three-line bottom headline below visible abs.
